name: Sliding glass doors
description: Chunky slate door frame with a mint stripe and a glowing motion sensor; two glass panels slide apart

nodes.DoorL: glass panel; pivot at its bottom centre, x = -0.765 when closed; open by moving -X by 1.47
nodes.DoorR: glass panel; pivot at its bottom centre, x = +0.765 when closed; open by moving +X by 1.47

mount: wall opening: origin at the floor centre of a 3.0 x 2.25 m opening, centred in the 0.3 m wall; +Z (front) faces outside. Panels slide into the wall.
notes: Glass material is 'Glass' (alpha 0.3, shared by both panels); swap it for the game's glare glass by name. Per-node materials are suffixed .DoorL / .DoorR.
